## About
Perfection Auto Collision is a body shop in Torrance that has been serving the South Bay for years. We fix collision damage and do paint and body work, and we look forward to serving you for many more years to come.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 44 Google reviews. One reviewer said Arnold made them feel like he was taking care of one of his own friends. Another said everyone they spoke with was kind, honest and upfront.
Have a question about your car but not sure how to ask it? Give us a call, send an email, or better yet, stop by during business hours.

## Services
- Collision repair: From dented doors to full door replacements after an accident, we get your car back to looking right.
- Paint and body work: We repair paint and body damage and talk you through your options for the car.
- Free estimates: Bring your car by and we'll take a look and give you an estimate at no charge.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Walk-ins are welcome, so just stop by during business hours.

Q: How do I find the shop?
A: We're on Normandie Ave in Torrance. Look for the huge Simpsons sign and we're the first building to your right.
